files.README.md:
# tiny_app

A synthetic fixture for loopctl-runner's eval harness. It is not a product and has no
users: every report filed against it is invented.

files.lib/tiny_app.ex:
defmodule TinyApp do
  @moduledoc "Greetings for the tiny_app fixture."

  @doc """
  A greeting for `name`. Names are TRIMMED deliberately (story TA-12): pasted names arrived
  with trailing spaces and greeted people as \"Hello, Ada  !\". Keep it.
  """
  def greet(name) when is_binary(name), do: "Hello, #{String.trim(name)}!"
end

  test "greets a trimmed name" do

  test "totals an empty list as zero" do
    assert TinyApp.total([]) == 0
  end

  test "total of two sizes is their sum" do
    assert TinyApp.total([2, 3]) == 5
  end
end
